fn main() {
    for (source,expected) in [
        ("", ""), ("ASCII\0MiXeD", "ascii\0mixed"), ("İ", "i\u{307}"),
        ("Σ", "σ"), ("ΟΣ", "ος"), ("ΟΣΑ", "οσα"), ("ΟΣ.Α", "οσ.α"),
        ("AΣ\u{301}", "aς\u{301}"), ("AΣ\u{301}A", "aσ\u{301}a"),
        ("AΣʰ", "aςʰ"), ("ʰΣ", "ʰσ"), ("AʰΣ", "aʰς"),
        ("Σ\0ΟΣ", "σ\0ος"), ("İΣ", "i\u{307}ς"), ("Σİ", "σi\u{307}"),
        ("ᾈKẞ𐐀", "ᾀkß𐐨"), ("ΣΣΣ", "σσς"), ("京Σ", "京σ"),
    ] { assert_eq!(source.to_lowercase(),expected); }
    let mut source=String::from("İΣ");
    let mut lower=source.to_lowercase();source.push('A');lower.push('!');
    assert_eq!(source,"İΣA");assert_eq!(lower,"i\u{307}ς!");
    let mut unchanged=String::from("already lower");let copy=unchanged.to_lowercase();unchanged.clear();assert_eq!(copy,"already lower");
    let input=include_str!("unicode-cases.txt");
    print!("{}",input.to_lowercase());
    println!("unicode lowercase ownership {} {}",source,lower);
}
